column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 4: Noah's Ark Punishment
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: W-what the hell is this place?!
What the hell?! Every last one of them is all torn to shreds!
I-I know... I used to work as a prison guard...
Those people have been horribly punished all over...
The lightest punishment in $$この世$$ is immediate execution...
The next lightest is death by torture—burning or boiling oil...
Vigorous, serious $$罪$$ offenders are made to work in mines where magma erupts until they die...
And people who've committed even graver $$罪$$ are made unable to live on their own...
Then they're thrown out into the city...
So their suffering will last as long as possible...
But people with the strength of will to deliberately commit the $$七つの大罪$$...
are taken to the $$バベルの塔$$,
where I hear they receive the most painful punishment in $$この世$$...
